author: Forbes
description:
Led by the vision of international bartending icons Shingo Gokan and Steve Schneider, Sip & Guzzle has established itself as a distinguished entry on the Forbes All-Star Eateries list in it's very first year. Nestled on Hudson Street in Greenwich Village, this dual-level destination is anchored in a trans-Pacific narrative that began in 1860, when 77 Japanese samurai visited New York and were inspired by the American bartending style of the legendary Jerry Thomas. Sip & Guzzle imagines a "return journey" for those explorers, fusing the meticulous, award-winning technique of Tokyo’s SG Club with high-octane New York hospitality.

On the street level, Guzzle functions as a lively New York-style tavern where Schneider holds court, serving "crushable" comfort drinks and perfect highballs designed for high-volume execution. This bustling "docks" atmosphere serves as the high-energy counterpoint to the downstairs experience.
